result.title: Dimension-Free Buffer Bounds for Compressed-Momentum Error Feedback
result.comment: Submitted to a journal and details will be confirmed once paper accepted
result.summary: Analyses of error feedback bound the memory buffer through a compressor contraction constant -- $r/p$ for the best rank-$r$ approximation of a $p$-dimensional spectrum -- which survives into the rate. We show it need not appear at all. When the compressed momentum is re-injected into the pre-compression accumulator, the previous compressed momentum $β_1 M_{t-1}$ is an admissible competitor in the projection, and the buffer obeys $\|E_t\|_F \le (1-β_1)\|G_t\|_F + γ\|E_{t-1}\|_F$, free of the dimensions $m,n$ and of the rank $r$. The argument uses only that the compressor is a metric projection onto a closed cone, so it covers top-$k$ selection as well as truncated SVD, holds for every selection from the projection set with no condition on singular-value crossings, and in its trajectory-tracking form assumes nothing about the gradients. In the two-stage template of the standard analyses it replaces a Stage-2 constant of order $p^2/r^2$ by one of order $1$, against $Θ(p/r)$ for the sharpest contraction-based bounds. Transferring the full rate costs a leakage term, which we bound by the step-weighted gradient mass $\sum_{u\le t}η_u\|G_u\|_F$ and show tight up to a factor $\sqrt{2}$; the price is an additive $O(\log^2 T)$ floor, not a slower rate. On BERT fine-tuning at rank ratio $32/768$ the feedback decay costs under $0.008$ validation $F_1$.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析压缩动量误差反馈的缓冲界，证明把压缩动量重新注入压缩前累积量后，误差缓冲满足不含维度 m、n 与秩 r 的递推，结论覆盖 top-k 与截断 SVD，并在 BERT 微调上实测反馈衰减的代价。
AI.relevance_reason: 误差反馈以残余缓冲持续把压缩丢弃的信息注入状态，可能为 latent 推理中压缩视觉细节后的信息保留、状态更新与容量需求提供可核查的抽象类比，但本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
